info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API allows consumers to retrieve information about refunds for deliveries made through the food delivery service. This endpoint provides detailed insights into the refund status, amounts, and the respective delivery instances. It is designed for use by customer service representatives and financial departments to facilitate refund inquiries and support operations. Users can leverage this API to enhance their understanding of refund processes and track ongoing requests effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve a refund for a delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a refund associated with a specific delivery. It is useful for tracking the status and information regarding the reimbursement process for returned items.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves refund details for deliveries. It must contain the necessary parameters to specify the refund request correctly.
